# Filter the row for "Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps"
row = df[df['Description Losses'] == 'Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps']

# Extract the year columns (excluding 'Description Losses' and 'Total')
year_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['Description Losses', 'Total']]

# Get the values for each year in that row
deaths_by_year = row[year_columns].iloc[0]

# Find the year with the maximum deaths (ignoring NaN/empty values)
max_year = deaths_by_year.idxmax()

# Assign the answer
answer = max_year
